title: Economics of Education
description: Original constructed exercises covering educational investment, returns and signaling, learning production, peer assignment, finance, access and policy evaluation. Prerequisites: introductory microeconomics, algebra, probability and introductory statistics; regression and causal-inference concepts are recommended for evaluation items. Bridge extensions use simple derivatives, conditional normal updating, present-value reasoning and sequential decisions. Source courses guide coverage rather than supplying copied questions or asserted empirical results. All monetary quantities, rules, institutions and effect sizes in scenarios are hypothetical.
